gloss: facilitator; moderator; master of ceremonies; emcee

definitions.gloss: facilitator; moderator; master of ceremonies; emcee

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{進行役|しんこうやく}は{田中|たなか}さんです。
{進行役|しんこうやく}を{務|つと}めるのは{初|はじ}めてで{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: It was my first time serving as moderator and I was nervous.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{進行役|しんこうやく}は{参加者|さんかしゃ}の{意見|いけん}をうまくまとめる{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The meeting facilitator needs to effectively bring together the participants' opinions.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はテレビ{番組|ばんぐみ}の{進行役|しんこうやく}として{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: She is popular as a TV show host.

notes:
A compound of {進行|しんこう} (progression, proceeding) and {役|やく} (role). Refers to the person responsible for keeping an event, meeting, or show moving forward smoothly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進行役|しんこうやく}を{務|つと}める: to serve as facilitator
- {進行役|しんこうやく}を{担当|たんとう}する: to be in charge of facilitating
- {会議|かいぎ}の{進行役|しんこうやく}: meeting moderator
- {番組|ばんぐみ}の{進行役|しんこうやく}: program host

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {司会|しかい}: emcee, host — more commonly used for formal events and ceremonies
- ファシリテーター: facilitator — the loanword, used more in business contexts
- {司会者|しかいしゃ}: host, master of ceremonies — emphasizes the person rather than the role
